name: Valbacken - Mariannelund
description: Valbacken to Mariannelund. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
waterSources: No verified potable water source is listed for this section; carry water and treat natural water.
notes: Current official Smålandsleden/Naturkartan calls the section HÖ3 Valbacken-Mariannelund, 16.7 km. OSM and route apps often use older names such as Delsträcka 4 Ingatorp-Mariannelund or Stage 6, with distances ranging from about 16.2 km to 25.8 km depending on packaging and variants.
Older OSM relation 10553744 computes to about 17.975 km and has its last point about 642 m from the current official Filmbyn endpoint.
The official connector text says 1.8 km, metadata says 1.9 km and computed official connector geometry is about 1.943 km.

Official pages list Åsjön as an active shelter with grill, beach and dry toilet; a 2020 field report described vandalism/litter/graffiti/no firewood, while later route-app tips again treat it as usable.

Official/local sources list cafe, toilet, water and restaurant services at endpoints, but field/route-app reports and official text indicate seasonal/opening-hour dependency, including Valbacken toilet closed in winter.
Some Visit Eksjö service pages include malformed or clearly wrong coordinate text. The HÖ3 synthesis uses official Smålandsleden/Naturkartan, OSM and facility-agent coordinates instead.

facilities.name: Valbacken ledentré HÖ2/HÖ3/HÖ4
facilities.description: Trail entrance and junction for HÖ2, HÖ3 and HÖ4 at Valbacken above Ingatorp, with parking and nearby seasonal ski-area/cafe services. Shared with HÖ2/HÖ4; deduplicate during normalization.

facilities.name: Åsjön shelter
facilities.description: Shelter for three people by Åsjön, with table group, grill place and a small sandy beach. Official text says a dry toilet is about 60 m toward Spilhammar. A 2020 field report found vandalism/litter/graffiti and no firewood, but later route-app tips again describe it as useful. Do not suppress without current official/field verification.

facilities.name: Åsjön fireplace
facilities.coordinateSource: OSM firepit coordinate; official Åsjön shelter page confirms grill place
facilities.description: Fireplace/grill at the Åsjön shelter cluster. Firewood availability is not reliable; field report in 2020 found no wood.

facilities.name: Åsjön dry toilet
facilities.coordinateSource: OSM toilet coordinate; official Åsjön shelter page says dry toilet about 60 m toward Spilhammar
facilities.description: Dry toilet near Åsjön shelter, on the Spilhammar/Mariannelund side of the shelter cluster. Coordinate is OSM-sourced and should be verified against official map object data if available.

facilities.name: Mariannelund Filmbyn ledentré
facilities.description: Official HÖ3 endpoint/trail entrance at Filmbyn in Mariannelund. The official object lists cafe/restaurant, entrance, toilet and parking. Endpoint service cluster should be modeled as access/town-service metadata unless individual Filmbyn facilities are separately normalized. No overnight caravan/motorhome camping at parking.

facilities.name: Filmbyn Småland / Restaurant Skogen
facilities.coordinateSource: Filmbyn visitor GPS coordinate from facility research; OSM museum coordinate nearby
facilities.description: Commercial visitor attraction and restaurant at the Mariannelund endpoint. Opening hours and restaurant availability are seasonal/currentness-dependent.

facilities.name: Anslutning Mariannelund - HÖ3
facilities.description: Unmarked connection between Mariannelund and Smålandsleden west of Spilhammar. The connector is useful for access planning but is not part of the HÖ3 section line. Description says 1.8 km, metadata says 1.9 km, computed connector geometry is about 1.943 km.

facilities.name: Spilhammars Camping
facilities.coordinateSource: Facility lane coordinate; official camping/Visit Eksjö sources corroborate the site at Spilhammarsvägen
facilities.description: Commercial campsite and accommodation near the Mariannelund endpoint and Spilhammar swimming area. Commercial/seasonal service; retain as nearby service metadata unless app import includes off-route commercial services.

facilities.name: Spilhammarsbadet
facilities.coordinateSource: Facility lane coordinate; Visit Eksjö/Spilhammar context
facilities.description: Bathing/swimming area near Spilhammars Camping, east of the HÖ3 endpoint. Off-route endpoint service; Check public access and exact facilities before importing separately.

facilities.name: Ingatorpsbadet
facilities.coordinateSource: Facility lane coordinate from official/local swimming site research
facilities.description: Off-route swimming/service option by Ingatorpasjön west of Valbacken. Off-route and not essential to HÖ3; retain as endpoint context only.
